## Biography & Summary
Dulshan Bandara is a Sri Lankan VFX & Composite Artist, Commercial Director of Photography (DOP), Video Editor, and DaVinci Resolve Colorist. He executes the complete commercial production and post-production pipeline—from on-location tabletop and studio cinematography, lighting, editing, and color grading in DaVinci Resolve to Blender 3D modeling & physics simulations, After Effects 3D camera tracking & compositing, and AI-assisted video workflows (Higgsfield, Beeble, InVideo, Figma Weave).

## Career & Academic Credentials
- **Commercial DOP, Editor, Colorist & VFX Artist** — Direct Commercial & Agency Productions (2024 – Present): Directing and executing solo end-to-end commercial campaigns, tabletop food cinematography, DaVinci Resolve color grading, 3D visualizers, and AI-assisted video workflows.
- **VFX Artist** — Sky Films International, Nugegoda, Sri Lanka (Jun 2024 – Mar 2025): Delivered broadcast-quality VFX, 3D modeling in Blender, chroma keying, 3D tracking, and motion graphics for national television commercials including People's Bank, Uswatte Chirpy Chips, SINGER, PickMe Flash, Little Lion, Rich Look, Eva, and Unilever.
- **BSc (Hons) in Information Technology – Specialising in Interactive Media** — Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT), Malabe (2022 – 2026).

## Technical Pipeline & Core Skills
1. **Cinematography & Lighting (DOP):** Tabletop food cinematography, studio spotlight framing, high-speed slow-motion capture.
2. **Video Editing & Color Grading:** DaVinci Resolve (Rec.709 commercial grading), Adobe Premiere Pro (rhythmic editing, split-screens, bilingual subtitle localization).
3. **VFX & Compositing:** Adobe After Effects & Blender (3D camera tracking, match-moving, green screen chroma keying, rotoscoping, screen & sky replacements).
4. **3D Modeling & Simulations:** Blender (3D environments, product packaging, atmospheric meteor fire/smoke simulations, fluid & particle simulations).
5. **Motion Graphics & End Cards:** Kinetic typography, 3D/2D product windows, architectural wireframe reveals, brand idents.
6. **AI Video & Relighting Workflows:** Higgsfield, Beeble (SwitchX relighting), InVideo, Figma Weave.
